roster.title: Characters
roster.search: Find by id, name or brief
stage.title: Character stage
stage.pick: Pick a character from the roster to see it from four sides.
stage.unknown: There is no character with the id {id}.
stage.noFrames: No frames yet: this character is {state}. Only its brief exists.
stage.compareHelp.raw: Showing the raw source frame. Raw frames are the generator output before the palette, outline and anchor pass.
stage.compareHelp.split: Left half raw, right half processed, gold line at the seam.
stage.compareHelp.diff: Gold: colour changed. Red: only in raw. Green: only in processed.
stage.noRaw: No raw frame for this one.
stage.hitboxFallback: No hitbox is defined for this character; the dashed box is the sprite bounds.
stage.pivotHelp: Click the selected facing to move the pivot, then save it in the Frame tab.
stage.turnaround: Turnaround: space plays, left and right step frames
stage.timeline: Frames of the selected clip and facing
stage.assumedMs: * The project defines no frame time for this clip; {ms} ms is assumed for preview only.
stage.projectMs: Frame times come from the design manifest.
panel.label: Character details
panel.pick: Select a character to see its frame, cross-facing check, card and export.
frame.notEditable: This frame is not in the editable catalog, so it cannot be changed or reviewed here.
frame.cannotPublish: Cannot be published into the atlases yet:
frame.pivotHelp: The pivot is the frame metadata the engine anchors on. The foot point ({foot}) comes from the character's anchor file or profile and is read only.
frame.head: Head r{head}, showing r{shown}
frame.conflict: Someone saved a newer revision (r{head}). The latest version was reloaded; try again.
review.title: Review
review.humanOnly: Approval is a human decision and exists only here, never as an agent tool.
review.note: Note for the author (optional for approval)
facing.help: Clip {clip}, frame {n}, every facing side by side. Gold boxes are rig landmark boxes.
facing.diffLabel: Difference map between west and the mirror image of east
facing.verdict.identical: Identical when mirrored: east is a mirror copy, so any asymmetric detail (weapon hand, ear mark) is on the wrong side for one of them.
facing.verdict.close: Close ({n} of {of} pixels differ): drawn separately or lightly corrected.
facing.verdict.different: Different ({n} of {of} pixels differ): drawn separately.
facing.noPair: This character has no west and east pair of equal size to compare.
facing.marksHelp: From the rig. A mark must sit in its box on every facing; marker colour {color}.
facing.noRig: No rig, so no registered marks to check. Compare the facings by eye.
card.help: Assembled from the manifest, the provenance files, the rig and the motion library. It is read only.
card.creator: Creator
card.noProvenance: No provenance file was found for this character.
card.noRig: No rig for this character. Rigs are made in the forge (studio/forge).
card.noMotion: No motion templates apply: the character has no rig or body plan yet.
export.help: A contact sheet of every clip, one row per facing, as a PNG you can attach to a review or a brief.
stage.bakeNote: Showing the forge bake from the experiment folder. These frames are not in the editable catalog.
export.limit: Sheets are limited to {mp} megapixels, so this character can be exported at up to {max}×. Pick one clip to go higher.
export.tooLarge: Even at 1× all clips together exceed the {mp} megapixel limit. Pick one clip.
